name: Every Day
intro: You will use Every Day’s six example cards the way a real day goes: tick cards off, fix a mistake, look at a card’s history, take a day off and undo it, and finish a perfect day. We also check it keeps your ticks after a reload and with no internet.

steps.do: A white card at the bottom says “Welcome to Every Day”. Tap the small words “skip the tour” in its bottom-right corner.
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.

steps.do: Tap “🧪 Keep the examples to play with”.
steps.see: Six big cards: 🚶 Walk outside, 💊 Morning pills, 📞 Call someone, 📖 Read a bit, 💧 Drink water, 🙏 Quiet time. The top says “6 cards to turn over today” and the score says 0/6 today.

steps.do: Tap the 🚶 Walk outside card.
steps.see: Walk outside gets a ✅ and its number changes to 1 DAY RUN. The score says 1/6 today, and the top line says “5 cards to turn over today”.

steps.do: Oops — pretend that was a mistake. Tap 🚶 Walk outside again.
steps.see: The ✅ goes away, it goes back to 0 DAY RUN, and the score is 0/6 again.

steps.do: Tap 🚶 Walk outside once more.
steps.see: The ✅ is back and the score is 1/6.

steps.do: Tap the 💊 Morning pills card.
steps.see: Morning pills gets a ✅ and the score says 2/6 today.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “✏️ Change or remove a card”.
steps.see: A panel slides up listing all six cards, each with “change ›” and a “📅 history” button.

steps.do: Tap “📅 history” next to Walk outside (the first one).
steps.see: The panel shows “🚶 Walk outside”, “Run: 1 day · best ever: 1 · every day”, and a “Last 4 weeks” grid with one green square for today.

steps.do: Tap the dimmed part of the screen above the panel.
steps.see: The panel closes and you are back at your cards.
steps.tip: The panel’s Close button is hidden behind the purple Test copy bar, so tap above the panel instead.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: A card asks “What would you like to do?” with “🌞 Today’s cards”, “➕ Add a new card”, “🎬 Watch how it works” and “↩ Pick up where I left off”.
steps.tip: The card comes only on your first open of the day (or after 4 hours away). If you already opened Every Day earlier today and no card comes, tap ✅ and go to the next step.

steps.do: Tap “🌞 Today’s cards”.
steps.see: Your ticks are kept: Walk outside and Morning pills still have ✅ and the score is 2/6.
steps.tip: A card “Keep Every Day on your Home Screen” may pop up now — tap “Later”.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap the 📞 Call someone card.
steps.see: A yellow strip says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” Call someone gets a ✅ and the score is 3/6.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Then scroll down and tap “⚙️ Settings · I’m OK text · day off”.
steps.see: A Settings panel with two choices: “🤝 Let someone know I’m OK” and “🤒 Sick day / day off”.

steps.do: Tap “🤒 Sick day / day off”.
steps.see: It explains a day off keeps your runs going, says “You can take one day off every 7 days.” and has a “🤒 Take today off” button.

steps.do: Tap “🤒 Take today off”.
steps.see: The top now says “Today is a day off.” and the score line says “today · day off”. The cards you haven’t done say “DAY RUN · day off”; your three ticked cards keep their ✅.

steps.do: Changed your mind? Tap “⚙️ Settings · I’m OK text · day off” again, then tap “🤒 Sick day / day off”.
steps.see: It says “Today is a day off. Your runs are safe.” and offers “Undo — I’ll do my cards after all”.

steps.do: Tap “Undo — I’ll do my cards after all”.
steps.see: The day off is gone: the top says “3 cards to turn over today” and the score is 3/6.

steps.do: Tap 📖 Read a bit, then tap 💧 Drink water.
steps.see: Both get a ✅. The top says “One card left.” and “Just “Quiet time” and today is perfect.” The score is 5/6.

steps.do: Tap 🙏 Quiet time.
steps.see: The top says “All 6 done. That’s a perfect day.” The score is 6/6 and “perfect this week” shows 1.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it one last time.
steps.see: Still “All 6 done. That’s a perfect day.” with all six cards showing ✅ and 6/6. A perfect day, safely kept.
